messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Here's where Shop···· stands. The NerdQaxe++ was delivered on August 31, tracking ····. The swap went through, so the order now holds one Hammer Miner BC04, and your $81 is on the order with nothing further owed.

The B.04 is a pre-order shipping October 29. You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

One accounting step on the $81 is still ours to finish. The team picks it up today at 10am ET and confirms to your email.
The website says "In stock · ships in 2 business days" for the BC04
Used the order-swap skill

You're right, and my October 29 was wrong. I'm sorry. The B.04 is on the shelf in the US warehouse now and ships within 2 business days.

What's holding yours is not stock, it's that the $81 is authorized but not yet drawn, and the shipping hold doesn't lift until it is. That's the one step I can't run myself.

It's with the team for 10am ET today. Once it's drawn, the BC04 goes out within 2 business days and the tracking emails to you.
No I've been waiting and trying to get ahold of the "team" for almost a month now, they NEVER get back to me
Used the order-swap skill

I hear you, and the frustration is fair. You ordered July 25 and you're still chasing us.

What I can see is that replies did go out to (email hidden) on October 14 and 16 from (email hidden) Our mail has been landing in junk for some customers, so worth checking there and adding that address to your contacts.

On this one I've put it in writing with the order number, the $81 and exactly what needs doing, for 10am ET today. The $25 code HD-•••••• from October 9 is still yours to use.
They won't.

I can't promise you they will, and you've earned the right to doubt it. What I can do is make it impossible to miss: the request is on the order itself with the amount, the date your payment went through and the one action needed, so whoever opens Shop···· sees it.

The unit is on the shelf in the US. It's the drawn payment, not stock, standing in the way.

A full copy of this conversation goes to (email hidden) when we're done, so you'll have it in writing.
Have it writing for wh If the team doesn't get back to me

Then come straight back here and say "nothing happened". You don't need to re-explain any of it: the order carries the written record, and so does the transcript that comes to (email hidden)

For your record, in plain terms: Shop···· holds one Hammer Miner BC04, your $81 was approved on October 16 at 5:04pm Eastern, the balance is $0.00, and nothing further is owed by you. The only step left is ours, and it is not yours to chase twice.
I have been for a month; I just keep getting an AI response saying they'll get back to me. They don't

Fair, and honest answer: yes, I'm the automated first line here. A person steps in for anything I can't do, and drawing that payment is one of those things.

I've put it down a second time as a person-needed case on Shop····, so it sits in front of Abel and Georges rather than in a queue of order updates.
Are you able to do refunds?

No, money back to a card isn't mine to do. That's Abel or Georges.

What I can do myself is store credit, a swap to something else, and the order side of things.

Before you go that way though: your BC04 is sitting on the shelf in the US warehouse and it's already paid for. It's one step from going out the door, not weeks away. Is it the wait you want out of, or the unit itself?

Well, I paid $250 for a Nerdqaxe++ and a Bitaxe Supra Hex bundle, and was told the Bitaxe Supra Hex was out of stock, so they replaced it with 2 Bitaxes. I didn't want the Bitaxes, so I had to pay $81 more for a BC04, but I got credited for the value of the 2 Bitaxes towards the BC04 and not for the Bitaxe Supra Hex
Looked something up in Shopify

Let me lay the figures out, because they're better than you think.

Your bundle was $249: NerdQaxe++ at $129.70 and Supra Hex at $119.30. The Supra was never charged away from you. That $119.30 is sitting on the BC04 right now.

The G. were put on as a replacement at no charge to you, so there was no money of yours in them to credit.

The B.04 lists at $249 and is on your order at $195.51. $119.30 of that is your Supra credit, and $81 is the rest, tax included.
Okay but the total was supposed to be $250 for 10.2TH total, but I paid $325 for 12TH. So I paid another $81 for another 1.6TH.

Your maths is right, and I'm not going to spin it. $81 for 1.8 TH is about $45 a TH, where your bundle worked out near $24. The extra hashrate is the expensive part.

What it bought you is one tidy 6 TH unit instead of four small boards, which is what you said you wanted.

If that trade no longer looks worth $81 to you, say so and I'll check what else sits at that same price. Otherwise the BC04 goes out as soon as the payment is drawn.
There's something better?
Used the order-swap skill

Honestly, for what you've already got on the order, the BC04 is the best of that band. The only real step up in stock in the US right now is the Hammer Thor P2, 10 TH/s at $379, ships within 2 business days. More hashrate, but more money than the $81.

The NerdOctaxe and the Supra Hex are both off the shelf, so neither is an option.

My advice is to take the BC04. Want me to price the Thor P2 difference anyway?
No

Understood, we'll leave it as the BC04.

So where it stands: the unit is on the shelf in the US, your $81 is in, and the one step left is on our side. It's written on the order with the figures, and it's with the team for 10am ET today. Once that's done the BC04 goes out and the tracking emails to (email hidden)

If nothing lands, come back here and say so. You won't have to explain it again.
If I don't hear from anyone in the next few days, because I've been waiting for almost 3 months now for half of my order, I will be charging back because you guys are impossible to get ahold of.
Handed to the team · Chargeback threat; I cannot cap····payment or guarantee a reply, so this ne

I'm not going to argue with you about that, you've waited long enough to feel that way.

I've put it up as its own case, with your words on it and what needs doing, so it's in front of Abel and Georges at 10am ET today rather than behind other order questions.

The unit is on the shelf and your money is in. Give them today, and if you hear nothing, come back here.
I will be coming back. Show me what you said?

Here it is, close to word for word:

Order Shop····, (email hidden) Customer says he will charge back within days if nobody contacts him. Ordered July 25. The Hammer BC04 is on the shelf in the US but held on the $81 PayPal authorization from October 16, which is approved and not yet drawn. Draw it, lift the hold, ship the unit, and write to him.

That sits on the order too, so it's there whoever opens it. The transcript comes to your email when we close here.
It wasn't PayPal?
Looked something up in Shopify

The order's payments all run through PayPal Braintree, which is the processor our checkout uses, and that's what it's recorded as. Braintree also handles plain card payments, so if you put a card in rather than logging into PayPal, your end would show the card, not PayPal.

Either way the $81 on October 16 at 5:04pm Eastern is the same payment, approved and sitting on your order. If your statement shows something different, tell me what it says and I'll put that on the case too.
Put in the case I've been waiting almost 3 months
Looked something up in Shopify

Done, it's on the order now in your words: waiting almost 3 months since July 25 for half the order, the BC04 still not shipped, and that you'll charge back within days if nobody contacts you. Alongside it, the $81 approved on October 16 and the one action needed.

That's what whoever opens Shop···· sees first.
How many ppl are seeing these?

Two people handle this side of things, Abel and Georges, and the case goes to both of them, not to one inbox where it can sit unread. Anyone else on the team who opens your order sees the notes as well.

It's a small team, which is part of why you've had the silence, and also why a case with your order number and one clear action on it tends to get done quickly once they're in.
I will be back when they don't reply

Fair enough. Come back and just say "nothing happened", I'll have the whole thing in front of me.

Thanks for staying reasonable about it tonight, I know it hasn't been an easy few months with us. A copy of this conversation goes to (email hidden) once we close here, so you'll have the figures and the dates in writing.
What's the plan then for when they don't reply in the next few days?

Straight answer. You come back and say the word. First thing I do is check whether the $81 was drawn and the hold lifted. If it shipped, I give you the tracking there and then.

If nothing moved, I raise it again as a person-needed case with the extra days on it, and I don't let you re-tell the story.

The things I can do myself without anyone else are store credit and a swap to another unit. Money back to your card is theirs alone.
